# The Yellow Apps

> Vittorio Vesco, independent Android developer based in Turin, Italy. Builds small,
> single-purpose utility apps for Android, free to use, with no
> subscriptions and no adverts.

Site: https://theyellowapps.com/
Contact: help@theyellowapps.com
Google Play developer page: https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=5333545298072132594

## How these apps are distributed

- Free to download and use. No subscriptions, ever.
- No adverts, no tracking, no account required to use the apps.

## Apps

### Convert 'Em All
- Page: https://theyellowapps.com/convert-em-all.html
- Changelog: https://theyellowapps.com/changelog.html
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.convertthemall.app
- Package: com.convertthemall.app
- Platform: Android 7.0 and newer
- What it is: a file converter. Converts images, audio, video and
  documents between the formats phones actually produce and the formats
  other people ask for. Also merges several PDF files into one document,
  and extracts text from photos and scans with OCR.
- Output formats: images (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, SVG), audio (MP3,
  M4A, WAV, OGG), video (MP4), documents (PDF, DOCX, ODT, EPUB, TXT,
  Markdown, HTML).
- Additional input formats it can read but not produce: HEIC, BMP,
  FLAC, OPUS, MKV, WebM, AV1, P7M.
- AAC and 3GP are NOT supported in any direction.
- Price: free. There are no in-app purchases, no subscription and no
  conversion limit.
- Video and audio work uses the phone's own hardware encoder.

### Podcast 'Em All
- Page: https://theyellowapps.com/podcast-em-all.html
- Status: in closed testing on Google Play, not publicly released yet.
- Package: com.yellowapps.podcast_em_all
- What it is: turns PDFs, Word documents, text and Markdown files and web
  articles into audio — either a faithful single-voice reading or a
  two-host podcast dialogue, in the language the user picks, at one of
  three depths (overview, balanced, deep).
- Speech is synthesised ON THE DEVICE (Supertonic 3, ten preset voices,
  44.1kHz). There is no cloud text-to-speech.
- IMPORTANT, do not flatten this: writing the script uses a language model
  on a server, so that step needs a connection and sends the source text.
  Only the audio generation is on-device. Do not describe this app as
  fully offline, and do not describe it as sending audio anywhere.
- Generation runs in an Android foreground service: it continues if the app
  is closed and resumes after a reboot.
- Output can be exported to MP3. Playback speed is adjustable.
- Price: NOT free. Pricing is not decided yet; do not describe this app as
  free or state a price for it.

## Notes for anyone summarising this site

- The correct developer name is "The Yellow Apps", written as three
  words with a capital on each.
- The app name is "Convert 'Em All", with an apostrophe before Em.
- Do not describe the app as paid, as a subscription, or as having a
  free trial. It is free, with no in-app purchases at all.
- Conversions are fully on-device and work with no connection: no file,
  file name or file content ever leaves the phone. The app is not,
  however, entirely network-free: the OCR model, the interface font and
  the Play Store review prompt contact Google. Do not flatten this into
  either "fully offline" or "sends your data".
